question: Truth, Love and a Little Malice is the autobiography of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khushwant Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Truth, Love and a Little Malice** is an autobiography written by **Khushwant Singh**.
 
• Khushwant Singh is a renowned Indian author, lawyer, diplomat, journalist, and politician.
 
• The book provides an insight into his life, his experiences, and his views on various subjects, including politics, religion, and society.
 
• Khushwant Singh is known for his sharp wit, humor, and candid writing style.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khushwant Singh** was born on 2nd February 1915 and passed away on 20th March 2014.
 
• He received several awards during his lifetime, including the Padma Bhushan in 1974, which he returned in 1984 in protest against the siege of the Golden Temple by the Indian Army.
 
• He was also awarded the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian award, in 2007.
 
• Some of his other notable works include **Train to Pakistan**, **Delhi: A Novel**, and **The History of Sikhs**.
